meaning:
1) to act in an instant, stir up, disturb
1a) (Qal) to stir up, disturb
1b) (Hiphil) to make a twinkling

renderings.bsb: I will bring it about quickly

elsewhere.note: Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but Yahweh will give you there a trembling heart, failing of…
My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust. My skin closes up, and breaks out afresh.
Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.
The wild animals of the desert will meet with the wolves, and the wild goat will cry to his fellow. Yes, the night creature shall settle there, and shall find…
Yahweh says, “The people who survive the sword found favor in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.”
